title: The Shadow Weaving Course
summary: A course in drawing shadow into threads and sheets and weaving them into screens that hide the student and snare the foe.

title: A Course in Smothering Strikes
summary: A course in blows that put out a flame or a glow on contact and press the dark into the target's breath.

title: The Second Primer of Veils
summary: A second primer for students who can already dim their own outline; it builds veils that cover groups and turn blows aside.

title: The Passing Shadow Course
summary: A course in stepping through a shadow to leave it at another point and in striking from the shade just stepped out of.

title: Course of the Cold Dread
summary: A course in letting dark qi press on the nerve of a foe so that fear weakens the arm before the first blow lands.

title: The Ink Hand Course
summary: A course in spreading darkness from the fingers like ink in water so that it stains the air and clings to whatever it touches.

title: Lessons in Light Eating
summary: A set of lessons in drinking the light from a lamp or a glowing technique until the area round the student goes dark.
